name: +1 Assassin Leveling
desc:
🗡️ Become the deadliest Assassin! Train your Strength, slash through powerful enemies, and unlock legendary daggers as you level up!
🎁 NEW CODES: LEVELING, WORLD5, 14KCCU, THANKYOU

🖱️ Click to gain +1 Strength!
⚔️ Unlock epic daggers, each stronger than the last!
🏆 Earn Wins and climb the leaderboards!
🥚 Hatch pets for powerful boosts!
🔄 Rebirth to become even stronger!
📈 Level up and grow stronger with every hit!
👥 Play with friends for +10% Strength each!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to support future updates!
